(a) Definitions. Contractor Employees - The term “contractor employees,” as used in this solicitation and contract language, refers to employees of the prime contractor or its subcontractors, affiliates, consultants, or team members. Sexual Harassment - As defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, sexual harassment is a form of sex discrimination that violates Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. The Northwest Fisheries Science Center (NWFSC) Environmental Chemistry Program (ECP) requires a comprehensive multi-year service and support agreement for its AB SCIEX ExionLC AE liquid chromatographer coupled with QTRAP 5500 tandem mass spectrometer (LC-MS/MS) systems. The requirement comprises one base year and 3 subsequent option years to ensure uninterrupted operational capacity. The service contract must include, at minimum: 1. Preventative Maintenance (PM): The PM has to be conducted by AB Sciex certified field engineers to ensure the system operates within Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications. One annual on-site visit for both LC and MS systems. Replacements of parts with OEM parts. 2. Corrective Repair: Unlimited on-site repairs conducted by AB Sciex certified field engineers to assure instrument returns to its peak performance and OEM specifications. On-site repair within 2 business days from the call for LC systems and 3 business days for MS systems. All service repairs will be performed by AB SCIEX’s certified field engineer. 3. The Contracting Authority is an ETB responsible for the delivery of services in county Kerry and is one of 16 ETBs established under the Education and Training Boards Act 2013. The remit of Education and Training Boards, as statutory provider s of education, is the provision of a comprehensive range of quality education programmes to meet the needs of the community we serve. These can include, Primary and Post Primary Education , Post Leaving Certificate Programmes, Further Education, Apprenticeships, Second Chance Learning, and Adult & Community Education. Education and Training Boards (ETBs) are statutory authorities which have responsibility for education and training, youth work and a range of other functions. Formerly known as Vocational Education Committees (VECs) ETBs manage and operate second‐level schools, further education colleges, multi‐faith community national schools and a range of adult, further education and training centres delivering education and training programmes, including 19 (former FÁS) training centres. 1. Introduction

The African Union Development Agency – New Partnership for Africa Development (AUDA-NEPAD) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Resilient Irrigation for a Sustainable Economy Project”, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. “Consultancy Services to Develop and Deploy the Africa RISE Gateway”

 

  1. Description of Services

The consulting services (“the Services”) include: Task 1: Africa RISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and proc

ISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and process workflows, including a unified data interoperability Layer that meets vPIC standards and aligns with the Africa RISE Regional Geospatial Analytics Platform and national irrigation monitoring systems.  The architecture shall specify: (a) the endpoints and payload schemas through which national data collection tools, the Regional Geospatial Platform,  and other authorized external data sources submit and validate benchmarking data; (b) the data lineage and version control mechanisms ensuring that published benchmarks are traceable to their submission source; and (c) the traffic-light alert logic that translates performanc

sociated training materials for all user groups, comprising: (i) a Technical Track for AUDA-NEPAD IT personnel, national technical focal points and system administrators, covering system administration, data management, integration and cybersecurity; (ii) an Operational Track for programme managers, extension officers and policy stakeholders, focusing on effective use of the platform and its functional modules; and (iii) an End-User Track providing simplified guidance and orientation materials. Task 4: Sustainable Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Model for the Gateway: Assess the technical and operational requirements for sustained operation of the Gateway, including hosting, security, data management, updates, user support and maintenance schedules and prepare indicative annual cost projections for the post-project period. Task 5: Envisaged functionality of the Africa RISE Gateway: The Africa RISE Gateway, as a go-to information and knowledge solution, is envisaged to serve.

f_Work.docx ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) RFID Cabinet The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), requires the acquisition of a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) storage cabinet integrated with Unique Device Identifier (UDI)-compliant tissue and implant tracking software to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, and efficient inventory management. Tracking tissues, biologics, and implantable medical devices is a federal regulatory requirement under FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI) and is critical to patient safety. VA healthcare facilities face ongoing resource challenges including staff shortages and budget constraints, making it essential to minimize staff time consumed by manual data entry and to maintain precise control over high-value inventory. This acquisition will provide an automated, real-time RFID-based inventory management solution for use in the operating room (OR), Catheterization (Cath) lab, ambulatory surgery center, or any facility location that stores high-value implantable inventory. Kombination von mindestens 150 m/min bei 1.200 × 600 dpi nicht auf ein einzelnes marktverfügbares System beschränkt ist. Insoweit stehen mehrere Systeme zur Verfügung, die die geforderten Leistungsparameter erfüllen. Auch an der Anforderung eines nachträglichen Speed-Upgrades vor Ort ohne Austausch des Drucksystems wird festgehalten. Diese Anforderung dient der langfristigen Zukunftsfähigkeit und Erweiterbarkeit der Investition. Eine spätere Steigerung der Produktionsleistung soll möglichst durch ein Upgrade des vorhandenen Systems und nicht durch einen vollständigen Maschinentausch erfolgen können. Damit sollen insbesondere die langfristige wirtschaftliche Nutzung, die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems sowie die Vermeidung zusätzlicher Investitions- und Umrüstungsaufwendungen sichergestellt werden. Die vorgeschlagene Absenkung auf 150 m/min bei 600 × 450 dpi sowie eine Änderung der Anforderungen an das nachträgliche Speed-Upgrade werden daher nicht vorgenommen. The success of an integrated Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR) is a top national priority. Equally critical is the ability to support the continuum of care across operational and enterprise healthcare environments, ensuring that health information generated during military operations can be captured, exchanged, and made available to support continued care within the enterprise health record.
